update.identity: For fixed quadratic L_T(theta)=1/2(A theta-y)^T W(A theta-y), displacement s gives gain=-g_T^T s-1/2*s^T H_T*s. For s=-eta*g_S this is eta*g_T^T*g_S-eta^2/2*g_S^T*H_T*g_S.

groupProtection.theorem: For every nonzero z, max_g Delta L_g >= z^T H z >= mu ||z||^2 >0, mu=det(H)/trace(H). Thus uniform weights alone weakly improve all declared groups.
